title: Power to Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant cut, restored, IAEA says
summary: The plant lost connection to its sole 330-kilovolt (kV) external power line, forcing it to rely on emergency diesel generators for cooling and safety functions, the IAEA announced around noon local time. 10 hours later, the IAEA confirmed power had been restored.

title: Moldova 'buys zero Russian gas,' launches new power line to EU
summary: "For decades, Moscow used energy to blackmail us. No more: Moldova buys zero Russian gas," Moldovan President Maia Sandu said.

title: Europe's attendance at Abu Dhabi peace talks, clarified
summary: A senior EU official has confirmed to the Kyiv Independent that the EU, NATO, and the national security advisers of Germany, France, and the U.K. will take part in the talks.

title: 'Kyiv is not ready for this' — Ukraine's capital braces for another 'brutal' winter
summary: As temperatures drop, Kyiv residents are dreading a winter that may be harsher than the last. Russia's escalating attacks, including its mass use of faster, harder-to-intercept jet-powered drones, make locals fear not only for the city's electricity but also for heat, sewage, and food supplies. title: Ukraine strikes Russia's second-largest oil refinery in overnight drone attack, Russian governor says
summary: The attack caused large explosions at the Kirishi Petroleum Organic Synthesis plant, also known as the Kinef plant, around 800 kilometers (roughly 500 miles) north of Ukraine.

title: Ukraine will likely 'end up with a little bit different shape' after war, Trump tells 60 Minutes
summary: "​​There's a very important meeting taking place," Trump said. "I believe that that war is going to end and it's going to end soon. And the only reason it's going to end is because of me."
